title: ドキドキとわくわく (Doki-Doki to Waku-Waku)
description: Hina is going to sing in the school talent show. In the days before, she feels two kinds of pounding heart — nervous doki-doki and excited waku-waku — and slowly learns to tell the difference. A story about distinguishing anxiety from excitement, and discovering that one can become the other.
author: オリジナル
